args: Execute the scheduled 4x/day job discovery routine for Xiao: 1. Fetch fresh postings across Welcome to the Jungle, Indeed France, HelloWork, France Travail, and APEC matching Xiao's target roles (Digital Marketing Assistant, E-Commerce Coordinator, Social Media Specialist). 2. Parse candidate CV (cv.pdf) and evaluate each listing from 1.0 to 10.0 using gemini-2.5-flash with time.sleep(4) pacing (15 RPM limit). 3. Synthesize targeted cover letters and actionable CV tailoring suggestions for opportunities with score >= 8.0. 4. Record new matches in the Job Hunter Agent for Xiao dataset and prepare Gmail draft dispatches.
description: Scrapes 5 French job platforms (Welcome to the Jungle, Indeed, HelloWork, France Travail, APEC) 4 times a day (08:00, 12:00, 16:00, 20:00 Europe/Paris), computes 1-10 CV compatibility via gemini-2.5-flash, and prepares applications.
